subject: Orchid pilot: runway top-up vs. short extension — options and next steps
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orchidhealth.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@orchidhealth.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — pilot runway and credit options

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the smooth onboarding last month. We hit the integration pause on our EMR connector (vendor delay) and need to decide whether to:

- push the pilot end-date by 2 weeks, or
- purchase additional inference credits up front and continue running a smaller scope while the connector is resolved.

Could you share what the simplest short-term option looks like from Redwood? Two specific asks:
1) A short (2-week) no-cost extension on the timeboxed pilot, or
2) A priced credits bundle we can buy now (ballpark cost and any discount for this one-off).

We have finance on standby but they prefer a billed credit option if pricing is reasonable; contracting will need the SOW amendment if we extend.

Appreciate a quick overview — we need to decide by tomorrow EOD PST.

— Sanjay
Lead Data Product, Orchid Health

(attachment: orchid_usage_May-Jun.csv)

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot runway and credit options

Hi Sanjay — thanks for flagging. Short answer: we can do either, here are trade-offs and a clear recommendation.

Options (quick):
• Two-week time extension (no charge): preserves existing terms, simple SOW addendum — good if you need more calendar time and still expect the same usage profile.
• One-off credits purchase: buy 50k tokens (approx 450k tokens = our internal unit; see usage file) at a 12% one-time discount if paid now — lets you keep the pilot moving for a limited scope and avoids amending dates.

Recommendation: If integration delay is purely calendared (vendor ETA in 10–14 days), take the 2-week no-cost extension. If you want to continue testing a subset (eg. hallucination checks, rerank flows) while the connector is fixed, buy the credits — we’ll apply a 12% credit discount and push an invoice that doesn’t change pilot dates.

Numbers (ballpark for approval):
• Credit bundle: $6,800 list -> $5,984 after 12% discount for 450k tokens (covers typical daily test volume for ~10 days).
• Two-week extension: no charge — SOW addendum required, DocuSign link I can send.

I attached a short offer doc with both options and the usage export you sent. If you want a blended option (1-week extension + smaller credit pack) we can do that too.

Next steps:
1) You confirm which option by EOD tomorrow.
2) If extension: contracting@orchidhealth.com to sign SOW addendum I’ll route.
3) If credits: I’ll send PO/invoice and provide top-up instructions; Ben (cc) will confirm the discount approval.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0147
(attachment: redwood_offer_v1.pdf)

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orchid pilot runway top-up — discount confirmation

Priyom / Marissa —

Giving a quick thumbs-up to the 12% credit discount for a one-off purchase. Approve for this deal size (ORCH-POC-2027-17). A couple of notes for contracting:
- If they want the no-cost extension, limit the addendum to date only (no SLA/price changes).
- If they choose credits, finance needs the PO reference and we should avoid changing pilot scope/date.

I'll be available until 16:30 PT if you want me on the customer call.

— Ben
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Sanjay / Orchids contracting team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Based on your note and Ben’s approval we can proceed with the hybrid approach you asked about during the demo:

Agreement we can execute today:
- One-week complimentary extension to the pilot end-date (no change to scope).
- Optional top-up credit bundle (250k tokens) at 12% discount if you want to run focused tests during that week.

If you want to take the credit pack, we’ll invoice $3,300 (net after discount); payment via PO is fine. If you take just the extension, contracting can sign the SOW addendum and we’ll confirm the new end-date.

Action items:
- contracts@orchidhealth.com: reply with either "sign addendum" or "send PO for credits" and attach the PO/contract reference.
- Sanjay: if you want the invoice now I’ll loop finance and send out the net-30 invoice.

DocuSign SOW addendum: https://www.docusign.net/123456789
Invoice/PO link (if credits): https://billing.redwood.ai/invoice/create?deal=ORCH-POC-2027-17

Look forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Priyom Das
